description:
the wow! signal: the 72-second deep space signal never heard again - 15 August 1977 ko Ohio ke Big Ear Radio Telescope ne deep space se ek 72-second ka radio signal record kiya jise 'The Wow! Signal' kaha jata hai. Ye signal 1420 MHz hydrogen line par tha aur aaj 47 saal baad bhi science iska jawab nahi dhoondh payi. Kya ye aliens the ya kuch aur? Watch the full story on Raaz Files.

Is video mein: The Wow! Signal: The 72-Second Deep Space Signal Never Heard Again se judi unsolved mystery, real story aur mind-blowing facts -- poori kahani Hinglish mein, RAAZ FILES par.
